8.1.6 BufReq_ReturnType
[SWS_COMTYPE_00012] Definition of datatype BufReq_ReturnType ⌈
Name
BufReq_ReturnType
Kind
Enumeration
BUFREQ_OK
0x00
Buffer request accomplished successful. This
status shall have the value 0.
BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK
0x01
Buffer request not successful. Buffer cannot
be accessed. This status shall have the value
1.
BUFREQ_E_BUSY
0x02
Temporarily no buffer available. It’s up the
requester to retry request for a certain time.
This status shall have the value 2.
Range
BUFREQ_E_OVFL
0x03
No Buffer of the required length can be
provided. This status shall have the value 3.
Description
Variables of this type shall be used to store the result of a buffer request.
Available via
ComStack_Types.h
⌋
